description:
FREE. Verifies a quality score receipt against its content (re-hashes the content, checks the Ed25519 signature, which covers the score itself — so a forged or altered score fails).
USE WHEN you have a score receipt + the content and need to confirm the score is genuine.
RETURNS: { valid, details }. A 200 means verification ran — always read valid.

content.description: The content the score receipt was issued for.

receipt.description: A quality score receipt as returned by score_quality.

name: verify_quality

details.description: Per-check breakdown (e.g. hash match, signature valid).

valid.description: True only if the content/record matches the receipt AND the Ed25519 signature is valid.

title: Verify a quality score receipt
